semantic.justification: Task77 adds normal unmerged local-reference mouse input using actual ScInputHandler selected UTF16 text,ScModule ordered dispatch,ScViewData reference start/end and ScTabView block/function-set owners. Browser formula pointing precedes Commit and preserves the edit origin;ordinary cell dragging retains the active anchor while headers move their native cursor endpoint. Shift extends;Ctrl adds/subtracts native ScMarkData/ScMultiSel selections. This is bounded source-backed foundation work,not full Calc parity. Merged cells,fill/transfer/move,protected/alternate/split views,reference dialogs,external/3D/matrix calculation,EditEngine and complete VCL painting remain unported. React binds the sole controller draft and DOM caret,uses shared Writer/VCL pointer capture and styling,and paints reference rectangles separately from ordinary native marks. Browser viewport/physical scroll mapping and repeat capture are platform adaptations;desktop scroll acceleration and complete range-finder parsing remain unported.
